PNB SO Result 2026: Overview

The Punjab National Bank Specialist Officer Result is out on the official website. The result is out for the recruitment of 30 specialist officers (Junior Engineers) in Civil, Electrical and Mechanical Disciplines. The details of the vacancy can also be checked below.

How to Download PNB SO Result 2026?

The steps to download thePNB SO Result from the official website of the Punjab National Bank are given below. The result can be checked in the recruitment section of the bank’s website.

  • Go to the official website of the Punjab National Bank i.e. pnb.bank.in
  • Click on the Recruitment Section on the homepage of the website.
  • Open the ‘PNB SO Result 2026 PDF’
  • The Result will open in the PDF format including the name, roll number and interview schedule of the selected candidates.
  • Search if your roll number appears in the PDF. If Yes, then you are selected in the exam.
  • Save the result PDF for future reference.

Details Mentioned on the PNB SO Result 2026

The details mentioned on the PNB SO Result 2026 must be checked very carefully by the candidates who appeared in the examination. In case of any kind of discrepancy, aspirants must immediately contact the exam conducting authority.

  • Roll Number of shortlisted candidates
  • Registration Number (if applicable)
  • Name of the recruitment
  • Post Name
  • Interview schedule details
  • Important instructions for shortlisted candidates

What After PNB SO Result 2026?

After the release of the PNB SO Written Exam Result 2026, shortlisted candidates have been called for the interview round. The interview will be held between 30th July to 1st August 2026. The final merit list will be formed after the interview round only. Candidates who will be selected in the interview round will be called for the Document Verification. In the DV round, the original certificates related to the caste, domicile, educational qualifications of the candidates will be checked by official authorities.

PNB SO Interview Date 2026

The Punjab National Bank has also released the Interview Dates for thePNB SO Recruitment 2026 along with the PNB SO Result 2026 PDF. Candidates must check the interview dates very carefully so that they do not miss the date on which they have to appear for the interview round. The interview will test the personality of the candidates along with their intellect. This is the final round of the selection process followed by Document Verification.

PNB SO Result 2026 FAQs

Q. When will the PNB SO Result 2026 release?

A. The PNB SO Result for the written test has been released on 24th July 2026.

Q. What are the PNB SO Interview Dates?

A. The interview for the candidates selected in the written test will be held between 30th July to 1st August 2026.

Q. How many vacancies have been released for the PNB SO Recruitment?

A. A total of 30 vacancies are out for the PNB SO Recruitment 2026.

Q. What is the PNB SO Selection Process?

A. The PNB SO Selection Process includes a written test and interview.

Q. How many candidates have been selected in the PNB SO Written Test 2026?

A. A total of 257 candidates have been selected for the PNB SO Written Test.
